text: The company reported total consolidated revenue of $4.85 billion in FY2024, representing a 14.2% YoY growth.
Operating margin improved from 18.5% to 21.3%, driven by operational efficiency and reduced SG&A expenses.
Free Cash Flow stood at $820 million, enabling share repurchases of $300 million and dividend payouts.
Long-term debt maturities: $250 million due in 2026, with an average effective interest rate of 4.15%.
